events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! What's your favourite Liam Gallagher moment, from Oasis anthems to his solo hits?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine The Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since 'Imagine' dropped. A timeless message that still resonates today – what does this iconic album mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the pure joy of your first iPod? 25 years since Apple changed the game for portable music. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007's enduring legacy. What's your top Bond theme tune or favourite Bond actor?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering A Legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled impact of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Sending a huge happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Revolutionary Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling masterpiece, 'The White Album'. A truly diverse collection – what's your go-to track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary Queen frontman, passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Unforgettable Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Folk-Rock Masterpiece
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since 'Rubber Soul' dropped, marking a pivotal moment for The Beatles. What's your favourite track from this groundbreaking album?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically killed on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40.

angles.name: A Day To Remember
angles.copy: On this day, we reflect on the immense loss of John Lennon, 46 years ago. His music and message of peace continue to inspire.
